title: Summer (L'estate, Vivaldi, Op. 8 No. 2, RV 315), 3rd movement Presto 'Storm' — public domain. listen = the descending G-minor run of bar 10 (D5→G3, 16ths, played at 100 bpm so each note is 0.15 s); tour = the opening motif G4 F4 Eb4 D4 over the G3 pedal, with the pedal cut from 11 repeats to 2. Notes read from the Mutopia MIDI (summer-score-2.mid, violin I).
